profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.geoLocationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
profile.summary:
Donne Martin is an avid open source contributor (e.g. System Design Primer 350k+):

https://github.com/donnemartin

As a Tech Lead at Meta, Donne protects the privacy of 4 billion people by building products and systems to power all of Meta's risk reviews.

As an Engineering Manager at Meta, Donne previously supported integrity teams protecting people from real world harm.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Privacy Infrastructure
positions.description: • Protect 4 billion people's privacy by building products and systems to power all of Meta's risk reviews.

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Integrity Infrastructure
positions.description: • Protect 4 billion people from real world harm by building products and systems to stamp out crime on Meta.

positions.title: Open Source Contributor
positions.description: • Creator of several popular open source projects: https://github.com/donnemartin

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Data and Analytics
positions.description:
• Lead the launch and development of the company’s data engineering and analytics pipeline with AWS Kinesis, DynamoDB, Redshift, Lambda, Hadoop MapReduce, Apache Spark, Python, Splunk, and Tableau.

• Extract insights and analyze key performance indicators from engineering, sales, and marketing data.

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Cloud and Mobile
positions.description:
• Lead the launch and development of Vectorworks Cloud Services, an award-winning cloud and mobile CAD platform.

• Leverage Vectorworks Cloud Services to launch new cloud and mobile products and to explore new markets and business models.

• Lead and mentor a distributed team of 15 with 2 lead software engineers, 10 software engineers, and 3 QA specialists.

• Guide product direction with 'Lean Startup'​ and 'Lean Analytics' principles.

• Guide engineering processes, standards, and practices: Agile and Lean methodologies, automated build and deployment systems, dev/test/production tiers, automated testing, automated crash logging, and bug/task/wiki management systems.

positions.title: Engineering Manager, Core Technologies
positions.description:
• Lead the development and maintenance of core systems allowing the Engineering and QA teams to track the following: bugs, tasks, processes, metrics, automated tests, manual tests, performance bottlenecks, and application crashes.

* Lead and mentor 5 software engineers.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Analyze requirements of a graphical user interface testing a sensor network’s event-detection algorithm.

• Design an appropriate UML solution.

• Implement and maintain the GUI using Java Swing.
